absent_coverage: The orthogonal passive-skew (`ll`/`hh`) resistor/capacitor axis is NOT crossed with the ramp-rate axis: this first increment is not the complete spec/porting-plan.md Sec3.1 x Sec3.3 grid.
Rates below 500 V/s and above 1 MV/s are not simulated; the primary rate set is exploratory and no numeric ramp envelope is claimed or ratified (DR-003 Sec8).
Brownout / dip behavior (Sec3.4) and mismatch Monte Carlo statistics are separate follow-on scopes and are not exercised here.

PTAT/CTAT are left open-circuit; the temp_core startup artifacts of issue #86 are not solved here -- any affected point shows up as a 'nonphysical' node, a klt diagnostic, or a missing result in the per-point tables.
author: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (builder, issue #101)

definitions.physicality: every saved node within [-0.3 V, vf+0.5 V] for t>0 and settled supply current -i(BVDD) > 0; the t=0 sample (degenerate all-zero-supply solve) is reported separately
definitions.premature: first release precedes POR_RAW's first V_MID rise (or POR_RAW never rises)
definitions.quasi-static: Half-rate paired segment. 'consistent' when the VDD at which POR_RAW rises agrees within the tolerance (threshold-style measurement); 'censored' when POR_RAW rises after the ramp has ended (VDD already at its final value, so no VDD threshold is measured); 'rate-dependent' otherwise. The POR_RAW->RESETn release DELAY is a time-domain quantity (one-shot), so it is graded on the full/half ratio, not on VDD. Tolerances: VDD@POR_RAW within 0.05 V; delay ratio in [0.8, 1.25].
definitions.rate/window: V(VDD) = min(final_supply, rate*t) from a physical 0 V start; ramp duration = final_supply/rate, so each rate is independent of the swept final supply (no fixed-duration confound, gf180 DR-021). tstop = 3.63 V / rate + 15 ms hold after the longest ramp of the request. Pilot runs (tt/27C/3.3V and ss/ff/fs/sf at -40 and 125 C, 2.97 V) released 1.7-3.0 ms after POR_RAW rose, so 15 ms of hold is ~5x the slowest pilot release. A point that does not release within the window is reported as 'no_release within window', not as a proven non-release.
definitions.release/re-assert/runt: rising V_IH crossing of RESETn (Schmitt, starts LOW); re-assert = falling V_IL crossing while HIGH; runt = excursion above V_RUNT that returns without reaching V_IH; independent V_MID up/down crossing counters
definitions.resolution: max sample gap <= 20 us (= minimum detectable glitch width) and sampled VDD within 20 mV of min(vf, rate*t); otherwise a point with no detected failure is UNRESOLVED, not PASS
definitions.trace storage: committed traces are change-triggered (dV>=2 mV on any of VDD/RESETn/POR_RAW/IBIAS, or 1 ms anchor); the transition counts are re-derived from the stored trace and compared with the full-resolution result per point (`stored_trace.agrees_with_full_resolution`).

experiment.claim: Issue #98 -- NOT a spec claim (no ratified numeric ramp envelope exists: DR-003 Sec8; spec/porting-plan.md Sec3.3 defines only the SHAPE of the sweep). Records, for the unchanged assembled design/temp_por_top.sch (bias_core + temp_core + por_comparator + por_output_chain, real shared IBIAS node, real RESETn -> temp_core.EN feedback, nothing replaced by an ideal bias or ideal sensor load), whether RESETn is held low from 0 V and released once and only once across an exploratory set of constant-dVDD/dt ramp rates x {tt, ss, ff, sf, fs} x {-40, 27, 125 C} x {2.97, 3.30, 3.63 V}. Each rate is paired with a half-rate quasi-staticity guard segment. Grading is from the full-resolution RESETn/POR_RAW/IBIAS/VDD waveforms (sim/supply-ramp-top/ramp_checker.py), never from end-point measurements alone. This first increment is NOT the complete porting-plan grid: the orthogonal ll/hh passive-skew axis is not crossed in.
